name: departing passenger mandatory sequence
value_or_rule: arrival -> check-in (counter, kiosk or pre-checked online) -> weight check (passenger + carry-on) -> security screening or access control -> waiting area -> walk to stand -> boarding; no bag drop; no border control
sections_pages: Feldhoff 2022 pp. 2-5 Fig. 3; Feldhoff and Soares Roque 2021 'Passenger processing'; NUAIR/NASA 2021 Sec. 5.1.1.1 pp. 61-63
applicability: Generic vertiport; all-carry-on and domestic/Schengen assumption
limitation: Security screening is regulator-dependent (both papers leave it open); represent screening as a station whose service time can be switched between screening and access control, not removed
proposed_target: model_dictionary new rule row; scenario_protocol 'processamento terminal'

name: passenger weighing time
model_use: weight-check station service time (deterministic first pass)
limitation: Author assumption without data; used only as a placeholder for sensitivity

name: access control service time
model_use: VAR-005 when access control replaces full screening
applicability: Airport vertiport; access to manoeuvring area
limitation: Stated assumption without citation; not a screening time

name: carry-on baggage check service time
limitation: Stated assumption without citation; relation to weight check not specified by the authors

name: walk holding area to gate door
sections_pages: Preis and Hornung 2022 Table 3 p. 14; Table A1 B1/B6 pp. 19-20
model_use: passenger movement between waiting area and stand
limitation: Point value from 3 experts; depends on layout; replace by distance/speed when layout is fixed

name: enter gate (door to aircraft proximity)
sections_pages: Preis and Hornung 2022 Table 3 p. 14; Table A1 B2 p. 20
model_use: component of boarding sequence before PAR-008
limitation: Point value from 5 experts; no distribution

name: leave gate after deboarding
sections_pages: Preis and Hornung 2022 Table 3 p. 14; Table A1 B5 p. 20
model_use: component of deboarding sequence after PAR-009
limitation: Point value from 2 experts; low confidence

name: boarding completion event
value_or_rule: boarding of a passenger ends when the passenger is buckled up and ready for take-off; deboarding starts when the passenger unbuckles
sections_pages: Preis and Hornung 2022 Table A1 B3/B4 p. 20
model_use: timestamp definition for W_pax end and for R_ready
limitation: Definition only; the 73.0 s and 65.8 s values already in PAR-008/009

name: station LoS proxy thresholds
value_or_rule: counter check-in 180; self-service check-in 120; security screening 180; weight check 180 (Optimum upper bound)
model_use: station-level NALoS proxy (share of passengers waiting above threshold)
limitation: IATA ADRM first-class/fast-track values adopted by one author; alternative 0.167 time-factor set gives 200/20/100 s; not satisfaction

name: aircraft passenger readiness sequence
value_or_rule: arrival at stand -> deplaning complete and passengers clear of airside -> servicing (charging only if required) -> crew confirms aircraft ready for boarding -> gate opens (status = boarding) -> boarding complete -> system check -> operator dispatch -> departure slot revalidated
model_use: state machine for stand and departure readiness
applicability: Scheduled base case and FCFS benchmark
limitation: ConOps prescription for automated operations; durations not provided

name: mass declaration before departure
value_or_rule: departure readiness requires mass of every boarded passenger and carry-on registered on the load sheet (weight-and-balance before every flight)
sections_pages: Feldhoff and Soares Roque 2021 'Passenger processing'; ICAO Doc 10121 6.3.2 p. 6-6; Feldhoff 2022 pp. 3-4
model_use: justifies mandatory weight-check station and a readiness prerequisite
limitation: Mechanism transferred from airport/helicopter practice; specific VTOL mass rule text not re-read in this task
proposed_target: model_dictionary rule row linked to PC-01

name: no charging while passengers embark/on board/disembark
value_or_rule: base case: charging and passenger presence are mutually exclusive at the stand; overlap only as a later scenario with documented risk assessment, procedures and qualified staff
sections_pages: EASA CRD 2022-06 pp. 89-90 and 106-107 (UAM.OP.MVCA.205 subject and numbering)
applicability: Electric VTOL-capable aircraft under EU rules
limitation: Adopted wording of UAM.OP.MVCA.205 relied on project search log (Codex); not re-quoted here
proposed_target: confirms D2 decision; no dictionary change

name: battery swap excluded from base case
value_or_rule: battery swap is maintenance (Reg. (EU) 1321/2014) requiring certifying staff; not modelled as a turnaround alternative in the base case
sections_pages: EASA CRD 2022-06 p. 90; NREL 2023 p. vi (surveyed OEMs not considering swapping)
limitation: PAR-011 (349 s) may remain only as an explicitly labelled exploratory scenario

name: energy readiness for departure
value_or_rule: an aircraft is not dispatched until its state of charge covers the next mission (plus reserves once defined); charging is triggered by this condition, not by every landing
model_use: charging need condition in Phase C
limitation: Threshold value (mission energy + reserve) is undefined: no Eve/Joby energy data; NREL excluded reserves
proposed_target: VAR-008 basis; new VAR for SOC threshold (undefined)

name: charging declared in reservation
value_or_rule: charging need and its duration are declared in the flight plan/reservation; performed in situ at stand/parking or after repositioning, with repositioning time added to the reservation
sections_pages: NUAIR/NASA 2021 Sec. 5.1.1.6.4 p. 73; PTS-VPT-DSN p. 18 and C.200(f) p. 25; NREL 2023 pp. 19-20
model_use: maps directly to VAR-021 categories (stand / adjacent dedicated) and to scheduled admission VAR-018

name: charger queue discipline
limitation: NREL chose FCFS for least coordination and notes managed charging can increase throughput

name: peak DC charging power envelope
model_use: sensitivity bounds for charger power only
limitation: Not Eve/Joby specific; no charge curve; must not be converted into a charge duration without OEM energy data

name: vertistop no-local-charging scenario
value_or_rule: scenario class where only deboarding/boarding occur at the stand and no charger exists
sections_pages: NREL 2023 p. 1; Schweiger and Preis 2022 pp. 4-5 and 31; NUAIR/NASA 2021 p. 41
limitation: Not regulatory: the no-charging vertistop definition came from the FAA EB 105 draft and EB 105A treats vertistops as vertiports for design (p. 3)

name: aircraft unavailable at departure
value_or_rule: if aircraft needs minor maintenance, enplaning passengers are held in the terminal until it is released; if no substitute aircraft exists the flight is cancelled and passengers are re-accommodated
